Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the very first step by incorrectly identifying the King responsible for the 1925 Birthday Honours as King Edward VII. The 1925 Birthday Honours were actually appointed by King George V, who reigned from 1910 to 1936. Edward VII reigned from 1901 to 1910 and died before 1925. This initial identification error led the subsequent WebSurfer search to look for the birth year of the wrong king, resulting in an incorrect final answer (1841) instead of the correct birth year for George V (1865).
